note: What the pies let slip (home/pie-game.mjs; canon .spw/surfaces/wonder-about-pie.spw#exactly_one_pie). Mr. BoonWAP says one of these while he holds court; Mr. BaneWAP blurts one when he is foiled. A line can be said once it is unlocked by what the visitor has found — chapters read, wonders kept, sightings noticed, tellings heard — or done in the game. Each says one true thing about the land and grounds it in a chapter where it can be read. Rules: the Egg stays a mystery; the figure under the hat is never named; the warm slice is never explained. Unlock kinds: always · chapters (count read) · chapter (that chapter read) · wonders · sightings · tellings · waps · satisfied (clowns satisfied) · shared (slices shared with clerks or subjects) · sweetened (baneberries sweetened) · perfects · foils · reached (the furthest chapter a carry has reached, 1–15) · carried (chapters carried through) · wonback (chapters won back from Mimes Against WAP) · mimes (chapters the mimes have ever taken).

lines.speaker: boon
lines.line: A pie is never smaller. People hear a boast. It is only arithmetic, and I am very good at arithmetic.

ground.label: never smaller, the pie at the table

lines.speaker: boon
lines.line: Clowns understand pie better than bakers do. A baker wants it whole. A clown wants it shared, quickly, and in the eye.

lines.speaker: boon
lines.hint: Read three chapters.
lines.line: This city's glass is made of every knock it ever took. I have been bonked into a good deal of it. It holds me beautifully.

lines.speaker: boon
lines.hint: Keep three wonders in your almanac.
lines.line: The ants under the field keep torch-lit streets and do their business with the Genie. Not with me. I am, they tell me, too large to invoice.

lines.speaker: boon
lines.hint: Notice the figure under the hat three times.
lines.line: Someone keeps standing at my second place without sitting down. I have never once seen the hat land. I have poured the cup anyway.

lines.speaker: boon
lines.hint: Hear ten tellings.
lines.line: Every sentence in this city can be said a few ways. I have heard most of them. I prefer the ones with me in.

lines.speaker: boon
lines.hint: Give clowns WAP ten times.
lines.line: Every pie in a clown's eye is a slice of me. Do not fret on my account. I am never smaller. I am only, now, more widely known.

lines.speaker: boon
lines.hint: Carry the pie as far as Chapter Thirteen, the long table.
lines.line: The second place is not for whoever sits in it. It is for whoever it was set for. In my experience those are rarely the same guest.

lines.speaker: boon
lines.hint: Read Chapter Thirteen.
lines.line: The egg? I smelled it across the whole plaza once. Warm, unspent, and not for eating. I asked. Politely. Twice.

lines.speaker: boon
lines.hint: Foil Mr. BaneWAP three times.
lines.line: Mr. BaneWAP was re-sweetened at the bridge, and he still schemes. I think he would be lonely otherwise. So, I am told, would I.

ground.label: kind to him first, at the bridge

lines.speaker: boon
lines.hint: Throw five perfect slices.
lines.line: There are five of us, you know. Everyone counts four and stops.

lines.speaker: boon
lines.hint: Satisfy five clowns.
lines.line: The mimes are against me, I am told. Silently, and with great feeling. I have never felt so understood.

lines.speaker: boon
lines.hint: Share three slices with a feast clerk or a subject on an errand.
lines.line: A clerk with a DAMAGE slip only wants to write down that something happened. Give him a slice and he writes SETTLED, which is shorter and leaves more afternoon.

ground.label: the damage signed in his own name

lines.speaker: boon
lines.hint: Carry the pie through five chapters.
lines.line: Five chapters carried, and not one of them smaller. A book is a pie too, you know. I have checked the arithmetic.

lines.speaker: boon
lines.hint: Win a chapter back from Mimes Against WAP.
lines.line: You won a chapter back from the mimes. I heard it. Well, I saw it. They were very expressive about it.

lines.speaker: bane
lines.line: Foiled! Do you know what it costs to rent a wind? Neither do I. I have never once paid.

lines.speaker: bane
lines.line: Every scheme of mine has an off switch. It is in my contract. I wrote my contract. Badly.

lines.speaker: bane
lines.hint: Read Chapter Eleven.
lines.line: The empire was rented. The throne was rented. The crown was wasps. I have been meaning to speak to someone about the wasps.

lines.speaker: bane
lines.hint: Read Chapter Twelve.
lines.line: Something under my crust went sweet at the bridge. I am still deciding whether to be furious about it.

lines.speaker: bane
lines.hint: Keep five wonders in your almanac.
lines.line: You think the egg was the prize. The prize was being seen holding it. Nobody saw. Nobody ever sees a pie properly.

lines.speaker: bane
lines.hint: Carry the pie as far as Chapter Eleven, the rented court.
lines.line: Mx. BoneWAP built me a machine that measures a scheme's chances. It says no in a very kind voice.

lines.speaker: bane
lines.hint: Notice the figure under the hat five times.
lines.line: The hat is not mine. I tried it on. It would not come down to me.

lines.speaker: bane
lines.hint: Foil Mr. BaneWAP five times.
lines.line: BoonWAP and I need each other, you understand. Without a foil, a pie is only lunch.

lines.speaker: bane
lines.hint: Give clowns WAP twenty-five times.
lines.line: Clowns. Clowns! Every WAP is a pie I never got to auction.

lines.speaker: bane
lines.hint: Hear twenty tellings.
lines.line: I tried telling the story my way. There were already five ways, and none of them were mine.

lines.speaker: bane
lines.hint: Foil Mr. BaneWAP twice.
lines.line: Mimes Against WAP are not mine. They agree with me in silence, which is the only way anyone has ever agreed with me.

lines.speaker: bane
lines.line: I am made of baneberries. Bitter is a flavour, not a failing. The mimes understand this. They gather for me, and ask nothing, and say less.

lines.speaker: bane
lines.hint: Sweeten three baneberry clusters with a thrown slice.
lines.line: Stop throwing warm pie through my baneberries! They come back sweet at the core, and a sweetened berry refuses to scheme properly.

lines.speaker: bane
lines.hint: Let Mimes Against WAP take a chapter.
lines.line: The mimes have taken a chapter for me. They will not tell me which. They never tell anyone anything. It is the best service I have ever had.

lines.speaker: boon
lines.hint: Carry the pie as far as Chapter Two.
lines.line: The grove answers a beat late. I have counted. A beat late is still an answer, and an answer is worth waiting a beat for.

lines.speaker: bane
lines.hint: Carry the pie as far as Chapter Three.
lines.line: Two roads claim the same step. I announced that one of them would win. Now both of them will, the bad way, and you will have to walk them both.

lines.speaker: boon
lines.hint: Carry the pie as far as Chapter Four.
lines.line: Keys get filed smaller every year. Mine stays the size it is. Some doors are not for keys, and I have never once tried to slice one.

lines.speaker: bane
lines.hint: Carry the pie as far as Chapter Five.
lines.line: Two slips trying to be one harvest. I said the crack would widen. Saying it is most of the work; the rest is gravity, which is very loyal to me.

lines.speaker: boon
lines.hint: Carry the pie as far as Chapter Seven.
lines.line: An oath kept in fruit is still kept. I have kept one in pie, which is only fruit with ambitions.

lines.speaker: bane
lines.hint: Carry the pie as far as Chapter Eight.
lines.line: Water keeps a face without stealing it. I tried to teach it otherwise. The pond was polite about it, and did not learn.

lines.speaker: boon
lines.hint: Carry the pie as far as Chapter Nine.
lines.line: Nine honks, eight heard. The ninth is missing, and warm. I would not count it missing. I would count it kept somewhere.

lines.speaker: bane
lines.hint: Carry the pie as far as Chapter Ten.
lines.line: I announced the hall would tell the truth. It did. I had not asked which truth, and the beams had been waiting years to say it.

lines.speaker: boon
lines.hint: Carry the pie as far as Chapter Thirteen.
lines.line: The last door is shaped like a shell, and stays open. I leave the last line blank as well. It is the only slice anyone ever finishes.
